title: Match the Exact Target Substring
text: The target substring starts at the first awful and ends at the third awful, right before the period. A correct pattern should not include Truly or require a space after the final awful.

title: Length of the Middle Word
text: How many letters are in the word awful?

title: Why the Correct Pattern Works
text: The pattern r'awful\s\w{5}\s[a-z]*' matches awful, then a space, then one 5-letter word, then another space, then lowercase letters for the final awful.

title: Eliminate Patterns with the Wrong Boundary
text: The pattern `r'(awful\s){3}'` fails because it requires a space after the third awful, but the third awful is followed by a period in review\_2.

title: Avoid Character-Class Misinterpretation
text: In [awful]{3}, the brackets mean three characters chosen from a, w, f, u, or l. It does not mean the word awful repeated three times.
